human_scope_review: Owner explicitly approved merging M442 bank SMS capture/review/session repair and M443 screenshot biometric/merchant UI removal together after reviewing cross-PR conflicts. Both previously reviewed source scopes remain bounded; neither feature may modify balances, historical records, or certified storage authority. This manifest declares both actual patches versus original PR base because exact-head workflows use the old base SHA.
user_requested_changes: Prevent bank SMS permissions and consent state from being mistaken for an empty pending-review list on the Home screen.
Preserve one-time bank SMS consent across sign-out/sign-in for the same verified account without silently authorizing a different user.
Protect account identity and encrypted pending SMS: keep one owner's queue inaccessible while logged out, purge on explicit opt-out or different-account opt-in.
Resume earlier bank SMS review from original installation month in bounded cursor-based batches, with progress status instead of misleading zero.
Expose Android READ_SMS/RECEIVE_SMS permission, app tracking, signed-in profile and protected queue read failures as separate accurate statuses.
Prevent unreadable AndroidKeyStore SMS review data from being silently reported as zero or crashing Activity during resume.
Update exact-SHA release notes and add regression test coverage for the two Android screenshot failures.
Remove the Choose merchant and logo selector and associated merchant brand search and preview from editing or adding any transaction.
Stop rendering merchant logos or merchant name branding in transaction detail, list and compact Home views, replacing them with category icons.
Retain existing transaction IDs, amounts, historical merchantKey metadata, SMS dedupe, categories, receipts, and finance writes without migrating or deleting data.

Prevent spurious biometric relock on a transient Android inactive lifecycle event such as a screenshot while maintaining mandatory OS biometric checks after genuine paused, hidden or detached background transitions.
Update existing biometric and SMS finance UI source assertions and add screenshot/branding regression tests without weakening security or bypassing test guards.
Document exact changes and physical device testing requirement in main APK release notes.
